title: Quantum Semantic Dynamics: A Unified Framework for N-Dimensional Semantic Hilbert Spaces with Experimental Validation

contributions.purpose: 将量子语义扩展到 N 维 Hilbert 空间的统一框架
contributions.mechanism: 张量积语义空间 + 语义 Hamiltonian(H0+Vcontext) + 量子语义场论 + Lindblad 退相干 + Qiskit 实现 五组件
contributions.evaluation: 4 维空间制备保真度>98%;张量网络压缩降维 3-5 倍、语义距离误差<5%
contributions.domain: 量子自然语言处理/量子认知
contributions.source_quote: developing a comprehensive formalism extending quantum semantics to N-dimensional semantic Hilbert spaces

contributions.purpose: 声称给出语义系统“真量子关联”的实验验证
contributions.mechanism: Qiskit AerSimulator 上做 CHSH Bell 检验与纠缠测量
contributions.source_quote: We demonstrate Bell inequality violations (CHSH = 2.4 ± 0.1) providing experimental validation of quantum-like semantic behavior.

contributions.purpose: 刻画语义能谱与退相干
contributions.mechanism: 能级间距统计 + Lindblad 主方程模拟
contributions.evaluation: 能级呈 Wigner-Dyson(GOE)分布;退相干时标 τD 20-100 步、T1≈50 步,与经验语境稳定性相关 r=0.87(p<0.001)
contributions.source_quote: decoherence timescales of 20-100 operations that align with empirical context stability in human language processing

self_declared_provenance.quote: We developed a comprehensive mathematical framework extending quantum semantics to N-dimensional Hilbert spaces, building on [4].
Our framework extends quantum semantic theory [1] by connecting N-dimensional semantic Hilbert spaces to advanced quantum information processing.
We distinguish our endeavor from 'quantum-inspired' classical algorithms [32].

notes: 数据红旗(严重):所谓“Experimental Validation”全部为 Qiskit AerSimulator 模拟,既非真实量子硬件亦无真实语言数据,却反复包装成“experimental/empirical validation”证明量子语义——循环自证、伪科学;CHSH=2.4 由构造生成,对“语义态”而言无物理意义。code 造数:QuTiP 片段对 N_dim>4 用 np.random.rand(N_dim,N_dim) 伪造 V_context 算子。所有指标异常凑整、集中一张 Table 无数据出处/无种子/无数据集。checklist AI 披露自曝研究过程为角色扮演:主代理 spawn 带出生年(-32000,+32000)与 back-story 的子代理('alicanto'/npcsh),并自述 AI“the boldness with which claims were made, declaring definitively”。Broader Impacts 过度声称“as demonstrated empirically in both neural systems and LLMs”(无支撑)。checklist 却答 [Yes] 有误差棒、[Yes] 开源(实为片段+计划)。四元组以论文自声明 major/minor 贡献归纳。reject。
